| api      | combineSinks           | `combineSinks`           | `@axe/core/events`         | Fan events out to several sinks, isolating failures.                                                                |
| api      | parseUserAgent         | `parseUserAgent`         | `@axe/core/events`         | Parse the recommended `User-Agent` form into an event agent.                                                        |
| api      | isOk                   | `isOk`                   | `@axe/client`              | Narrow a result to `ok`.                                                                                            |
| api      | isNeedsInput           | `isNeedsInput`           | `@axe/client`              | Narrow a result to `needs_input`.                                                                                   |
| api      | isNeedsHuman           | `isNeedsHuman`           | `@axe/client`              | Narrow a result to `needs_human`.                                                                                   |
| api      | isPending              | `isPending`              | `@axe/client`              | Narrow a result to `pending`.                                                                                       |
| api      | isError                | `isError`                | `@axe/client`              | Narrow a result to `error`.                                                                                         |
| api      | allowed                | `allowed`                | `@axe/client`              | Whether `policies.agents` permits this client's vendor.                                                             |
| api      | retries                | `retries`                | `@axe/client`              | Client option: retries after `rate_limited` or `unavailable` (default 1).                                           |
| api      | maxRetryAfterMs        | `maxRetryAfterMs`        | `@axe/client`              | Client option: longest `Retry-After` honored automatically.                                                         |
| api      | maxWaitMs              | `maxWaitMs`              | `@axe/client`              | Poll option: give up after this long.                                                                               |
| api      | toolNameFor            | `toolNameFor`            | `@axe/mcp`                 | MCP tool name for an action (dots become underscores).                                                              |
| api      | formatResult           | `formatResult`           | `@axe/mcp`                 | Render a result envelope as MCP tool content.                                                                       |
| api      | pollBudgetMs           | `pollBudgetMs`           | `@axe/mcp`                 | How long a tool call polls `pending` before returning (default 20000).                                              |
| api      | isAxePath              | `isAxePath`              | `@axe/fetch`               | Whether a path is one AXE serves.                                                                                   |
| api      | toWebRequest           | `toWebRequest`           | `@axe/express`             | Convert a Node request to a Web `Request`.                                                                          |
| api      | sendWebResponse        | `sendWebResponse`        | `@axe/express`             | Write a Web `Response` to a Node response.                                                                          |
| api      | invokeAction           | `invokeAction`           | `@axe/testing`             | Invoke an action in-process and return the envelope.                                                                |

| api      | formatConformanceTable | `formatConformanceTable` | `@axe/testing`             | Terminal table for a conformance report.                                                                            |

| api      | onActionEvent          | `onActionEvent`          | `@axe/core`                | Hook receiving action events, the ledger lines handlers record with `emit`.                                         |
| api      | emit                   | `emit`                   | `@axe/core`                | Handler context: record an action event for the `onActionEvent` sinks.                                              |
| api      | ledger                 | `ledger`                 | `@axe/surface`             | Read the ledger: every act and refusal, oldest first, with `since`, `actor`, `limit`.                               |
| api      | freeze                 | `freeze`                 | `@axe/surface`             | Mark every entry unavailable with a reason during a transient state; returns thaw.                                  |
| api      | thaw                   | `thaw`                   | `@axe/surface`             | Release one freeze; the last release restores the entries and moves the revision.                                   |
| api      | surfaceAttributes      | `surfaceAttributes`      | `@axe/surface`             | The attributes a rendered control carries for an entry (name, id, kind, reason).                                    |
| api      | surfaceSelector        | `surfaceSelector`        | `@axe/surface`             | CSS selector that finds the rendered control for an entry id.                                                       |
| api      | describeEntry          | `describeEntry`          | `@axe/surface`             | One plain-text line for an entry: name, availability and reason, effect.                                            |
| api      | useSurfaceProps        | `useSurfaceProps`        | `@axe/surface/react`       | React hook that registers an entry and returns its attributes as props.                                             |

## Generate API

Public identifiers of `@axe/generate`, which derives actions from definitions an application already has (`docs/generating.md`). Kept in their own table so the SDK API table above stays stable.

| Category | Key                      | Name                       | Where           | Meaning                                                                       |
| -------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------- | --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| api      | fromOpenAPI              | `fromOpenAPI`              | `@axe/generate` | Action source: one candidate per OpenAPI 3.x operation, with an HTTP handler. |
| api      | fromFunctions            | `fromFunctions`            | `@axe/generate` | Action source: a table of zod-typed functions keyed by action name.           |
| api      | fromTRPCRouter           | `fromTRPCRouter`           | `@axe/generate` | Action source: a tRPC router's queries and mutations, read structurally.      |
| api      | registerGenerated        | `registerGenerated`        | `@axe/generate` | Register every generated action on a server.                                  |
| api      | formatWarnings           | `formatWarnings`           | `@axe/generate` | One line per generator warning.                                               |
| api      | jsonSchemaToZod          | `jsonSchemaToZod`          | `@axe/generate` | Convert the common JSON Schema subset to Zod, warning on the rest.            |
| api      | defaultRisk              | `defaultRisk`              | `@axe/generate` | Policy: risk for candidates whose source did not decide.                      |
| api      | maxRisk                  | `maxRisk`                  | `@axe/generate` | Policy: leave out actions above this risk.                                    |
| api      | requireInputDescriptions | `requireInputDescriptions` | `@axe/generate` | Policy: leave out actions whose input fields lack descriptions.               |
| api      | includeDeprecated        | `includeDeprecated`        | `@axe/generate` | OpenAPI option: keep operations the document marks deprecated.                |
| api      | createContext            | `createContext`            | `@axe/generate` | tRPC option: build the router context from the AXE handler context.           |
